title: Arithmetic check
instructions: Answer all four questions. You need 70 to pass, and you can retry as often as you like.

questions.explanation: // divides and rounds down, so 7 // 2 is 3. Plain / would give 3.5.
% gives the remainder. 10 = 3 x 3 + 1, so the remainder is 1.
Multiplication happens before addition: 3 * 4 is 12, then 2 + 12 is 14.
The / operator always gives a float, even when the answer is a whole number.
